subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu: send text + multiple images as a single interactive card

question: Should Feishu text or presentation plus image attachments automatically collapse into one interactive image card, require a Feishu-scoped opt-in, or wait for a generic presentation image block?
rationale: The missing code path is clear, but the trigger and fallback policy change user-visible Feishu delivery semantics and need owner intent before automation should implement or close the issue.

options.title: Opt-in Feishu image cards
options.body: Add a Feishu-scoped opt-in first so existing text-plus-media sends keep sequential behavior unless the sender requests a card.

options.title: Automatic image cards
options.body: Compose one card whenever Feishu sends include text or presentation plus image attachments, with sequential fallback on upload or card failure.

options.title: Wait for generic presentation images
options.body: Defer this feature until the cross-channel presentation contract grows an image block instead of adding Feishu-first behavior.

recommendation.title: Opt-in Feishu image cards
recommendation.body: Add a Feishu-scoped opt-in first so existing text-plus-media sends keep sequential behavior unless the sender requests a card.

likelyOwner.reason: m1heng is the declared Feishu plugin owner and the decision is Feishu-specific send semantics.
